question: Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?
sql:
SELECT driver_id, AVG(daily_count) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM (
    SELECT d.driver_id, o.order_created_day, o.order_created_month, o.order_created_year, COUNT(*) as daily_count
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN orders o ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
    WHERE d.driver_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.driver_id, o.order_created_day, o.order_created_month, o.order_created_year
) as daily_counts
GROUP BY driver_id
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 10
